versions.changelog:
- Introduced a new brainstorming skill for creative work, focusing on collaborative dialogue to explore user intent and design
- Follows a structured process: understanding ideas through targeted questions, exploring 2-3 alternative solutions, and presenting designs in sections
- Outputs validated designs as documentation and commits them to git
- Integrates with other skills for detailed implementation planning and domain-specific analysis (embedded, simulation)
- Emphasizes core principles like asking one question at a time, preferring multiple-choice questions, and exploring alternatives before finalizing
